diagnoses.description: When an agent spins up a helper (HTTP server, browser, jsdom bridge) to self-verify a static web artifact, it must guarantee the helper is torn down before returning, or use an ephemeral resource that cannot collide with the harness. diagnoses.description: When the scene has strong depth parallax (e.g., walking/dolly POV with near objects), a single 2D affine/homography cannot align background across frames, so residual-difference masks either flood with parallax noise or, after aggressive thresholding, collapse to near-empty. The skill assumes a globally warp-able background and provides no branch for parallax-dominated scenes or a way to verify the alignment is trustworthy before differencing.

diagnoses.description: The output-validation skill enforces schema/format only (keys, CSR integrity, label set) and has no plausibility signal on the payload itself. diagnoses.description: When post-processing OCR text to extract monetary values, the extractor requires a canonical decimal separator (a literal '.') so any OCR noise on the decimal glyph (rendered as ':', ' ', joined digits, or omitted) causes the correct value on a correctly-matched keyword line to be dropped, producing a spurious null.

diagnoses.description: Priority keyword tiers use strict whitespace-separated word-boundary regexes (e.g. r'\bGRAND\s+TOTAL\b'), but Tesseract frequently glues adjacent words ('GrandTotal') or inserts stray characters ('Grand Total.', 'GrandTotal ='), so higher-priority tiers silently miss and the extractor either falls to a lower/wrong tier or emits null.
